```artifact
## UML Testing Profile (UTP)

**Test Suite Name:** System Backup and Report Generation

**Target System:** Virtual Medical Assistant System

**Test Suite Version:** 1.0

**Test Suite Date:** 2023-10-26

**Test Suite Author:** Senior Software Test Engineer

**Test Suite Description:** This test suite covers the functionality of backing up the system and generating reports.

**Test Case ID | Test Case Title | Requirement ID | Test Case Type | Preconditions | Inputs | Steps | Expected Results**
---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---
TC-001 | System Back-up | Req-13 | Positive | System is running | None | The system automatically performs a full back-up of both database and code at 12:00 AM every night. | The back-up is successfully created and sent to the remote site.
TC-002 | Back-up Rotation | Req-13 | Positive | Back-up is created | None | The system rotates the back-up files every 30 days. | The oldest back-up is deleted and the new back-up is stored.
TC-003 | Invalid Password | VIRTUA-13-1 | Negative | User is logged out | Username and invalid password | The user is unable to log in.
TC-004 | Valid Password | VIRTUA-13-1 | Positive | User is logged out | Valid username and password | The user is successfully logged in.
TC-005 | Patient Registration | VIRTUA-13-2 | Positive | Patient is not registered | New patient information | The patient is successfully registered and a user account is created.
TC-006 | Doctor Appointment Report | VIRTUA-13-3.1 | Positive | Report is requested | Date range for next 5 days | The report is generated with appointment details for the specified date range.
TC-007 | Consultation Report | VIRTUA-13-3.2 | Positive | Report is requested | Month/quarter/year | The report is generated with consultation data for the specified period.
TC-008 | Revenue Report | VIRTUA-13-3.3 | Positive | Report is requested | Month/quarter/year | The report is generated with revenue data for the specified period.

```
